## 1. Setup & Data Loading

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
library(scales)
library(ggthemes)
library(DT)
```

```{r load-data}
# Johns Hopkins COVID-19 time-series URLs
base_url  <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CSSEGISandData/COVID-19/master/csse_covid_19_data/csse_covid_19_time_series/"
cases_url  <- paste0(base_url, "time_series_covid19_confirmed_global.csv")
deaths_url <- paste0(base_url, "time_series_covid19_deaths_global.csv")

# Helper: pivot JHU wide → long format
load_jhu <- function(url, metric_name) {
  read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(Province = `Province/State`, Country = `Country/Region`) %>%
    select(-Lat, -Long) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols      = -c(Province, Country),
                 names_to  = "DateStr",
                 values_to = metric_name) %>%
    mutate(Date = mdy(DateStr)) %>%
    select(-DateStr) %>%
    group_by(Country, Date) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(metric_name), sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

cases  <- load_jhu(cases_url,  "Confirmed")
deaths <- load_jhu(deaths_url, "Deaths")

covid <- cases %>%
  left_join(deaths, by = c("Country", "Date")) %>%
  filter(Date >= ymd(params$start_date)) %>%
  arrange(Country, Date)

cat("Dataset: ", nrow(covid), "rows |", n_distinct(covid$Country), "countries\n")
cat("Date range:", format(min(covid$Date)), "→", format(max(covid$Date)), "\n")
```

## 2. Daily New Cases & Deaths (Global)

```{r global-daily}
global <- covid %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(Confirmed = sum(Confirmed),
            Deaths    = sum(Deaths)) %>%
  mutate(
    NewCases  = pmax(Confirmed - lag(Confirmed, default = 0), 0),
    NewDeaths = pmax(Deaths    - lag(Deaths,    default = 0), 0),
    Roll7Cases  = rollmean(NewCases,  k = 7, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    Roll7Deaths = rollmean(NewDeaths, k = 7, fill = NA, align = "right")
  )

ggplot(global, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = NewCases), fill = "#aec6e8", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Roll7Cases), colour = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title    = "Global Daily New COVID-19 Cases",
       subtitle = "Blue line = 7-day rolling average",
       x = NULL, y = "New Cases") +
  theme_clean()
```

```{r global-deaths}
ggplot(global, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = NewDeaths), fill = "#f5a9a9", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Roll7Deaths), colour = "#d62728", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title    = "Global Daily New COVID-19 Deaths",
       subtitle = "Red line = 7-day rolling average",
       x = NULL, y = "New Deaths") +
  theme_clean()
```

## 3. Top Countries by Total Cases

```{r top-countries}
top_countries <- covid %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(TotalCases  = max(Confirmed),
            TotalDeaths = max(Deaths)) %>%
  mutate(CFR = TotalDeaths / TotalCases) %>%
  slice_max(TotalCases, n = params$top_n_countries)

datatable(
  top_countries %>%
    mutate(
      TotalCases  = comma(TotalCases),
      TotalDeaths = comma(TotalDeaths),
      CFR         = percent(CFR, accuracy = 0.01)
    ),
  caption  = paste("Top", params$top_n_countries, "Countries by Total Confirmed Cases"),
  rownames = FALSE,
  options  = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "t")
)
```

## 4. Case Trajectory Comparison

```{r trajectory-plot}
top_names <- top_countries %>% pull(Country)

covid %>%
  filter(Country %in% top_names) %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  mutate(NewCases = pmax(Confirmed - lag(Confirmed, default = 0), 0),
         Roll7    = rollmean(NewCases, k = 7, fill = NA, align = "right")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = Roll7, colour = Country)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_colour_tableau(palette = "Tableau 10") +
  labs(title    = paste("7-Day Rolling Average New Cases —",
                        "Top", params$top_n_countries, "Countries"),
       x = NULL, y = "New Cases (7-day avg)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_clean() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 5. Case-Fatality Rate Over Time

```{r cfr-trend}
covid %>%
  filter(Country %in% head(top_names, 5)) %>%
  mutate(CFR = ifelse(Confirmed > 0, Deaths / Confirmed, NA)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = CFR, colour = Country)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_colour_tableau() +
  labs(title    = "Case-Fatality Rate (CFR) Over Time — Top 5 Countries",
       subtitle = "CFR = Total Deaths / Total Confirmed",
       x = NULL, y = "CFR (%)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_clean() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 6. Summary

```{r summary-table}
summary_stats <- global %>%
  summarise(
    `Total Confirmed Cases`  = comma(max(Confirmed)),
    `Total Deaths`           = comma(max(Deaths)),
    `Global CFR`             = percent(max(Deaths) / max(Confirmed), accuracy = 0.01),
    `Peak Daily New Cases`   = comma(max(NewCases,  na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Peak Daily New Deaths`  = comma(max(NewDeaths, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

knitr::kable(summary_stats, align = c("l", "r"), caption = "Global COVID-19 Summary Statistics")
```

*Data source: Johns Hopkins University CSSE COVID-19 Dataset.
